title: Talk
description: Talk's page settings: ~/.sessionkit/voice/settings/talk.json. Read by `talk serve` on every page load (src/talk/server.py talk_settings); no restart. Drawn by Settings; `ears services install` writes this copy as .talk.schema.json (a dot schema beside each file).

$schema.description: This schema's name, when the file names it.

show_debug.title: Show Debug in Talk
show_debug.description: A Debug button in Talk's row of names, for testers: every partial, who it reached, and the turn detector's score at each pause. Off: no button, and the debug view is off.
show_debug.x-hint: For testers: every partial, and who each line reached.
